metadata.author: Disney
metadata.description: Welcome to Zootopia! Where dreams are big, and even the smallest hero can make a huge difference, in this junior novel retelling of the Disney's Zootopia.  From the largest elephant to the smallest shrew, the city of Zootopia is a mammal metropolis where various animals live and thrive. But newly arrived Officer Judy Hopps discovers that being the first bunny on a police force of big, tough animals isn’t so easy. Determined to prove herself, she jumps at the opportunity to crack a mysterious case, even if it means partnering with fast-talking scam-artist fox Nick Wilde to solve the mystery.
